_about: Per-file ceiling on `tsc --checkJs` errors over src/lib, src/stores and
src/composables (#666). Enforced by scripts/typecheck.mjs via
`npm run typecheck`.
This is a ratchet that is meant to reach zero, which makes it different
from the coverage thresholds and the payload budget: those hold a good
number steady, this one retires a bad one. Every error under it is a
@param or @returns block that no longer describes its function, in the
layer whose doc blocks are the contract callers read.
It is per file rather than one total on purpose. A single number lets a
new error in one module hide behind a fix in another, and a ratchet that
can be gamed that way stops being believed.
Lower an entry whenever you fix some, and delete it at zero. Never raise
one: a new error means a doc block and a signature disagree, and the fix
is to make them agree — or, where TS narrows correct JS badly, to say so
with a reason, as src/types/globals.d.ts does.
91 errors across 30 files on main @ 4f20d33 (2026-09-10) — 38 TS2339,
1 TS2561, 1 TS2554. The fixes are #666's second half and land separately,
against the tree left by the #657/#665/#667/#668/#669/#670 queue rather
than the tree they were first written for.

Down one from 92/31: #657 landed two new errors in vocabBuild.js while this branch was open, the ratchet caught them, and fixing them took that file to zero — so its entry is gone rather than lowered.
